# FlowCFO
> AI-powered virtual CFO for founders, freelancers, e-commerce brands, agencies, and restaurants.

FlowCFO is a financial intelligence platform that connects to your bank accounts, predicts cash flow, calculates tax reserves, and tells you exactly how much you can safely spend.

## Key Features
- **Safe-to-Spend**: Know your available liquidity in real-time
- **Cash Flow Forecasting**: 90-day AI-powered cash flow predictions
- **Tax Reserve Engine**: Automatically calculate and set aside tax reserves
- **Vertical CFO Agents**: Industry-specific analysis for e-commerce, freelancers, agencies, restaurants, and startups
- **AI Advisor**: Context-aware financial guidance powered by AI
- **Plaid Integration**: Secure bank account connections
- **Payout Analysis**: Platform fee and payout optimization for e-commerce sellers

## Supported Verticals
- **E-commerce**: Gross margin tracking, platform fee analysis, inventory health, seasonal patterns, payout reconciliation
- **Freelancers**: Income smoothing, tax readiness, quarterly tax reserve calculation
- **Agencies**: Client profitability, revenue diversification, project-based cash flow
- **Restaurants**: Food cost analysis, labor cost optimization, daily revenue tracking
- **Startups**: Burn rate monitoring, runway forecasting, fundraising readiness

## Pricing
- **Starter**: $19/mo — 2 bank connections, basic cash forecasting
- **Growth**: $49/mo — 5 bank connections, tax reserve engine, AI advisor
- **Scale**: $99/mo — Unlimited connections, multi-entity, API access, priority support

## Technical Stack
- **Frontend**: Next.js (React), Tailwind CSS, BetterAuth
- **Backend**: Python FastAPI, PostgreSQL (asyncpg), SQLAlchemy, Alembic
- **Infrastructure**: Docker, Leapcell (hosting), Neon (PostgreSQL), Redis
- **AI**: Llama (NVIDIA NIM), Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini
- **Banking**: Plaid API
- **Email**: Resend
